'Target weapon attack gains +1{p}. / Reprise - If the defending hero has defended with a card from their hand this chain link, your next attack this turn gains +1{p}.'

Unlike Overpower, the Reprise clause here ADDS a separate effect rather than replacing the pump -- there is no 'instead' -- so the +1{p} is unconditional and the queued bonus is gated. MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK queues a one-shot on the controller, consumed by the first attack that follows; MODIFY_ATTACK would move THIS attack twice.

Reprise (CR 8.4.x) is 'the defending hero has defended with a card FROM THEIR HAND this chain link' -- DEFENDER_USED_HAND_CARD, which the engine records per chain link. Equipment defending does not count, which is the whole point of the keyword.
